description_en: Queries the list of services purchased by the user
description_zh: 查询用户已购买的服务列表
kebab_example: aliyun market describe-instances --product-type 1 --page-number 10 --page-size 1 --codes cmgj000112,cmgj000113 --except-codes cmgj000114,cmgj000115 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.description_en:
The commodity type. Valid values:
- APP: application
- SERVICE: service
- MIRROR: image
- DOWNLOAD: download
- API_SERVICE: API
- ROS: resource orchestration
- DOCKER: container
- IOT: IoT.
